messages.subject: WorldClim down
parts:
It has been brought to my attention the WorldClim site is down. This will crash Wallace if you are trying to use the WorldClim Bioclims module.

Also, if you are seeing a message in your R terminal regarding expiring packages, please update to the latest version of Wallace (2.1.0), which has these packages removed!

-The Wallace Team
